description: Richard's return opens a season of escalating reversals as Peter's hidden past, Taylor's connection to him, Kimberly's illness, Michael and Megan's marriage, Sydney and Craig's partnership, and Amanda's struggle for control of the advertising agency repeatedly turn romance into leverage. Even departures are rarely allowed to happen peacefully.

s05e01.description: Richard torments Jane after surviving her murder attempt, while Amanda learns that Peter's identity conceals a dangerous Kansas City past.

s05e02.description: Jane becomes convinced Richard is alive, leading Sydney to suggest the least dignified possible reassurance: digging up his grave.

s05e03.description: Jane and Sydney escape Richard after a violent confrontation, only to encounter him again before police finally end the threat.

s05e04.description: Peter fires Sydney for selling his house to cover practice debts and is forced into Amanda's apartment as his finances collapse.

s05e05.description: Jane rescues Jake and Alison from a fire, then turns jealousy into a clumsy attempt to seduce Billy.

s05e06.description: Jane's fixation on Jake and Alison escalates into stalking and vandalism, prompting Jake to confront her and Jane to retaliate legally.

s05e07.description: Amanda and Peter's constant fighting drives Peter into temporary refuge with Michael and Kimberly, where peace is hardly guaranteed.

s05e08.description: Taylor reveals her connection to Peter's late wife and uses Amanda's absence to become increasingly involved in Peter's personal life.

s05e09.description: Kimberly tries to end Megan's arrangement with Michael, but Michael refuses to let go and begins controlling Megan's other clients.

s05e10.description: Craig takes control of the advertising agency while Arthur secretly pays Amanda to supervise him and prevent the agency from disintegrating.

s05e11.description: Kyle chooses his marriage over Sydney, while Jane's search for her biological mother leads her to former actress Sherry Doucette.

s05e12.description: Kimberly pushes Michael away and encourages Megan to reclaim him, while Matt faces increasing pressure from Dan over their relationship.

s05e13.description: Sydney resents Jane's bond with Sherry, whose story about Jane's biological father proves less truthful than it first appears.

s05e14.description: Michael tries to repair Peter and Amanda's relationship for professional reasons, while Kyle's birthday matchmaking meets Amanda's resistance.

s05e15.description: Michael marries Megan in Las Vegas as Peter reveals Kimberly's brain tumor, while Jane's boutique is shaken by an armed robbery.

s05e16.description: Michael stays close to terminally ill Kimberly, who privately tells Megan she intends to end her life during the next rainstorm.

s05e17.description: Kimberly rescues Michael after their crash, but his injuries become life-threatening while Megan summons help.

s05e18-19.description: Megan worries about Michael's devotion to Kimberly, and Kimberly suffers a seizure after Michael chooses an evening with his wife. Kimberly asks Michael to fulfill a final intimate wish, while Amanda exploits Craig's attraction to regain half of the advertising agency.

s05e20.description: Megan learns about Michael and Kimberly, forgives him, then nearly lets jealousy turn a surveillance trip into vehicular revenge.

s05e21.description: Nick gathers evidence of Taylor and Peter's affair, while Megan discovers Kimberly's supposedly terminal illness has entered remission.

s05e22.description: Taylor drugs Nick as Peter retrieves compromising photographs, then stages the scene so Kyle believes Nick attacked her.

s05e23.description: Amanda refuses Craig's attempt to turn their night together into a relationship, while Kyle finally recognizes Taylor's pattern of lies.

s05e24.description: Michael takes Megan back after she returns to prostitution, while an accident at the boutique exposes Sydney to an expensive lawsuit.

s05e25.description: Kimberly collapses during an argument and learns she has an aneurysm, yet refuses the surgery that might save her.

s05e26.description: Kimberly's mother wants to take her dying daughter home to Cleveland, while Michael argues that the trip itself could be dangerous.

s05e27.description: Jake and Alison leave Los Angeles looking for somewhere to marry, and a breakdown in a small town unexpectedly solves the problem.

s05e28.description: Sydney sees opportunity in her injuries and lawsuit, while Craig decides seduction may be the cheapest way to neutralize her claim.

s05e29.description: Jennifer unexpectedly encounters former lover Kyle and forces him to revisit the Boston affair he abandoned without explanation.

s05e30.description: Amanda and Kyle pursue divorces to protect their jazz-club interests, while Sydney settles her lawsuit rather than damage Craig.

s05e31.description: Michael and Taylor drug Peter and invent a neurological disorder to convince him he becomes violent during blackouts.

s05e32.description: The jazz club opens amid romantic strain, while Sydney challenges Amanda's authority at the advertising agency and Kyle's decision to hire Jennifer creates friction.

s05e33-34.description: Sydney and Craig launch a rival agency by stripping the advertising agency of staff and clients, leaving Amanda's business in immediate crisis. Amanda watches her agency collapse while Alison prepares to leave Los Angeles with Jake and his newly reconnected family.
